This procedure details the testing procedures and calibration I1, which 
 recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block.
This relay ensures function 81 of ANSI-C37-2-1970 standard.

The HDG 7020 is a two level frequency relay whose characteristics of high 
 precision , rapid operating time , wide setting ranges and the possibility of 
 using each operating level either for over frequency or under frequency , make 
 it suitable for use in a wide range of application.

The first draft is initiated by Eng. Mohammed Fahmey Mashaal, tested by Eng. 
 Khalied Diab & Eng. Ehab Abu Elwafa at 19 August 2008, and accepted by General 
 Manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby Head 
 Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

DC. Circuit for frequency Relay.

Remove voltage terminals (10,11) from the relay as shown in

Connect test leads between the voltage terminals (10 11) on 
 the relay.
Increase the injection voltage to 110 V and frequency to 50 HZ

Increase the frequency slowly until the relay operates and 
 record over frequency (P.U) value and then stop the test set.

Restart the test set (with voltage=110v& frequency =over 
 frequency P.U value)

The relay will operate, the over frequency timer will account 
 and stop when the trip contact close.
Make sure that lockout relays (86GT&86T) operate.
Register the time value.

Decrease the frequency slowly until the relay return to normal 
 condition and record (REST) value.
Make reset to frequency relay & lockout relays (86GT&86T).

Decrease the frequency slowly until the relay operates and 
 record under frequency (P.U) value and then stop the test set.

Restart the test set (with voltage=110v& frequency=under 
 frequency P.U value).

The relay will operate, the under frequency timer will account 
 and stop when the trip contact close.
Make sure that lockout relays (86GT&86T) operate.
Make reset to frequency relay &lockout relays (86GT&86T).

Increase the frequency slowly until the relay return to normal 
 condition and record (REST) value.
Make reset to frequency relay & lockout relays (86GT&86T).
